difficulty_reason: The proof combines a type-theoretic full-faithfulness criterion with induction on truncation and a basepoint-transport argument; the finite truncation hypothesis is essential and retained.

compared.difference: The connected-truncated factorization task proves contractibility of a factorization space, not equivalence detection by homotopy groups. The general untruncated Whitehead principle is not asserted.
Hypercubical manifolds concerns a different cubical presentation, not this book claim.
A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
